requirements.requirement: The system must define a schema field 'phase' constrained to allowed values: 'I', 'II', 'III', 'IV', or 'N/A'.
The system must define a numeric field 'phase_score' representing normalized evidence maturity.
The system must constrain 'phase_score' to a numeric range between 0.0 and 1.0 inclusive.
The system must ensure the schema is implemented as a Pydantic model extension within clinical_trials_models.py.
The system must include both 'phase' and 'phase_score' fields in the same model object representing a clinical trial.
The system must allow 'phase' to be nullable or set to 'N/A' when source data is missing.
The system must enforce type validation such that invalid non-string values for 'phase' are rejected at model validation time.
The system must enforce type validation such that non-numeric values for 'phase_score' are rejected at model validation time.
The system must serialize the schema to JSON with both 'phase' and 'phase_score' fields present when values are available.
The system must reject any 'phase' value outside the allowed enumeration during validation.
The system must default 'phase_score' to null or a defined fallback when 'phase' is 'N/A'.
The system must raise a validation error if 'phase_score' falls outside the normalized range [0.0, 1.0].
